finding_this_session: PHASE 6'S RETRIEVAL COLUMN WAS MEASURING A CHAT TEMPLATE, NOT RETRIEVAL. The pinned /opt/llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-cli advertises -st/--single-turn and NOT -no-cnv/--no-conversation. The backend treated the two as interchangeable because both make the binary exit rather than wait at its prompt. They are not: llama-cli's own help documents -st as 'run conversation for a single turn only', so every prompt reached the model wrapped in its chat template. Proof, on the released base weights and therefore not a proxy-capability story: copy-control exact_match 1.0 through the torch backend, 0.0 through llama-cpp, same weights, with the template's own 'assistant' marker in the output (runs/eval/diag-llamacpp-template/). Stage A consequently read 0.0 for every arm, every task, every depth.
